tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mdo sdud pa'i 'grel pa rgyal ba'i dgongs gsal bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rgya chen tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'khrungs shing*/ /spangs rtogs bang rim mthon pos mngon par mdzes/ /mkhyen brtse nyi zla zung gi khor yug can/ /thub dbang sa 'dzin dbang por gus phyag 'tshal/ / ston pa mchog de'i nye ba'i thugs kyi sras/ /rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham 'jam dbyangs dang*/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyur rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sher phyin dar zhing rgyas mdzad sed+ge bzang*/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po btsong kha pa/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab bstan dar sogs/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mchog rnams rtag tu bsngags/ /rgyal bas chos tshul ji snyed gsungs rnams las/ /rab dang phul byung rgyal yum sher phyin te/ /de las shin tu bsdus pa sdud pa'i don/ /cung zad dbye bar 'dod kyis mnyan par rigs/ /de la 'dir 'phags pa sdud pa'i don gyi snying po rnams bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ rgyas par spros na ni rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan rnams dang rgyas par sbyar te bshad du yod kyang mang du dogs shing*/ 'on kyang sdud pa 'di brgyad stong pa dang don ston tshul mthun pas de gtso bor byas nas rgyan bcas cung zad re sbyar nas/ slob dpon sed+ge bzang po dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs rnams gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i rjes su 'brang ste 'chad par byed do/ /'di la gsum/ gzhung la 'jug pa dang*/ gzhung don dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gsum/ mtshan dang*/ 'gyur phyag dang*/ mtshams sbyar zhing 'jug tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du zhes sogs te/ 'di la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rgya skad la ār+ya nas gā thā zhes pa ste/ gnyis pa de nyid bod skad du bsgyur na/ ār+ya ni 'phags pa/ pradzña ni shes rab/ pā ra ma ni pha rol tu/ i ta ni phyin pa/ sañtsa ya ni sdud pa/ gā thā ni tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa ni lots+tsha bas bkod pa'o/

/gsum pa ni/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes pa na/ bka' stsal to zhes pa ste/ /sngar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa de nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das ky-is dge slong pha ma gnyis dang dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis te 'khor bzhi po dang*/ des mtshon nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams dang bcas pa de dag chos gtam kyis yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad pa'i phyir du/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa 'di ston pa'i thugs dgongs mdzad cing*/ de'i tshe tshig lhugs su ma mdzad par tshigs su bcad pa 'chad 'gyur 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis/ nyan par bskul ba dang*/ gzhung don dngos so/ /dang po ni/ dga' dang gus dang zhes pa nas/ mnyan par gyis zhes pa ste/ don nyan par 'dod pas dga' ba dang*/ de la yid ches kyis gus pa dang*/ don du gnyer ba'i dad pa'i mchog rnams ni blo la nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /de gsum ka'ang dad pa'i khyad par yin te/ slob dpon gyis 'di'i 'grel par/ dad pa'i bye brag rnams pa gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang nyan na shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa gnyis bsal ba ste spangs pa'i sgo nas dri ma'i skyon thams cad las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas don du gnyer zhing*/ 'gro ba'i don byed pa la mngon par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang byams snying rjes rgyud dul bar byas pas na des pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang la gzhi na don mdzad pa'i dpa' bo rnams spyod pa'i sher phyin de ni gus pas mnyan par gyis shig sbas don la sher phyin gyis mtshon pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa thams cad thos bsam bsgom gsum gyis nyams su longs zhes bstan to/ /gnyis pa gzhung don dngos la rjod byed kyi tshig la skabs brgyad dang*/ brjod bya'i don la dngos po brgyad yod cing phyi ma ni mkhyen pa gsum dang*/

sbyor ba bzhi dang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'o/ /'di dang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang pos rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu ston cing*/ chos bcu'i dang po ni sems bskyed yin la/ thog mar dpe don gnyis kyi sgo nas ston pa ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing*/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis dpe dang*/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas mthus byed rang gi stobs kyis mthus ma yin/ /zhes pas don dang sbyar ro/ /'di la gnyis/ tshig don dang 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan rab 'byor sher phyin 'chad pa por bskos pa na/ shā ri'i bu'i bsam pa la rab 'byor gyis sher phyin 'chad pa ni rang stobs kyis yin nam/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus yin snyam pa la sangs rgyas kyis de'i bsam pa mkhyen te de ni rang stobs tsam min gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus yin zhes yum gsum las rgyas par gsungs pa'i don 'dir bsdus pa yin pas/ de dang bstun na dpe ji ltar na/ dzam+bu'i gling 'dir chu bo gaṅgā la sogs chu klung chen po ji snyed cig 'bab cing*/ me tog 'bras bu dang ldan pa dang sman gyi rigs dang nags tshal sogs skyed par byed pa de ni/ rgya mtsho ma dros pa na gnas pa'i klu dang klu'i bdag po rgyal po ma dros pa de brten cing gnas pas te/ klu'i bdag po de'i mthu dang dpal te bsod nams las byung ba yin no/ /rgya mtsho de ni rgya gar gyi byang ngos dang bod kyi lho ngos gangs ti se dang spos dang ldang ba'i yang lho na yod cing*/ mchu zheng gnyis ka la dpag tshad lnga bcu re yod do/ /bshad pa zhig na mtsho de'i 'og na tsha dmyal yod pa'i 'od kyis ma dros pas na ma dros zhes bshad cing*/ ngos bzhi'i shar nas gad+gā/ lho nas pak+ṣu/ nub nas sin+dhu/ byang nas si ta ste chu klung chen po bzhi 'bab cing*/ de bzhi las chu klung gzhan sna tshogs byung ste 'dzam+bu'i gling la phan pa'i bya ba byed do/

/klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa de ni thams pa min gyi/ 'phags pa'i sprul pa klu'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /dpe de bzhin du rgyal ba'i nyan thos rab 'byor la sogs pa dag ni/ chos ji snyed cig gzhan la ston cing 'chad pa dang*/ rigs pa dag dang ldan cing mi 'gal bar brjod pa dang*/ kun gyi mchog dang khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ mthar thug gi bde ba dam pa myang 'das su bgrod par byed pa'i thabs la thos sogs kyi shes rab bskyed pa dang*/ de'i 'bras bu myang 'das thob pa de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu las byung ba yin no/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal bas dam pa'i chos tshul gang bstan pa de la ni mi mchog rgyal ba'i slob ma nyan thos su gyur pas/ thos pa'i shes rab kyis mngon par bslabs shing*/ bsam pa'i shes rab kyis don yid la mngon sum du byas nas bslabs pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzhan la ston par byed la/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi mthus byed pa yin gyi/ rang tsam gyi stobs kyi mthus byed pa ma yin no/ /spy-ir nyan thos kyis sangs rgyas las theg chen gyi chos rgya chen po nyan nas gzhan la de bzhin du ston par mdzad pas thos sgrogs pa zhes bshad kyang*/ de dag gis theg chen gyi mdo'i don rdzogs par nyams su len nus pa min no/ /'on kyang rab 'byor ni 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par bshad pas nyan thos dngos min cing*/ ston pas rab 'byor sher phyin 'chad pa por bskos pa la dgos pa che'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'og tu shes rab pha rol phyin zhes mang du 'byung bas de'i don 'dir cung zad bshad pa bzhin gzhan la ci rigs su shes par bya dgos shing*/ de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa tshig sdud du mdzad pa ni sher phyin zhes pa yin la/ de la sgras brjod tshul gyi dbang du byas nas yum gyi mdo las rjod byed tshig dang brjod bya don gyi sher phyin gnyis ka la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad cing*/

rjod byed tshig gi sher phyin ni yum gyi mdo rnams yin la/ brjod bya don gyi sher phyin la lam sher phyin/ 'bras bu sher phyin gnyis dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sher phyin dang gsum mo/ /lam shes phyin la dngos btags gnyis las dngos ni byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor rnams yin la/ rjes su mthun nam btags pa ba ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la'ang yod cing*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin gzhan yang yod do/ /'bras bu sher phyin ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na yin la/ rang bzhin gyi sher phyin ni stong nyid dang don gcig go /gzhung sher phyin ni lam 'bras kyi sher phyin brjod byar ston pas de'i ming gis btags la/ de yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i phar 'gram du shes rab kyis phyin zin pa'i dbang du mdzad pa ni 'bras bu sher phyin dang*/ phyin par byed pa ni lam sher phyin dang*/ de'i dmigs yul mthar thug yin pas na rang bzhin gyi sher phyin du bzhag pa yin te/ khyad par phyed par bya'i/ thams cad gcig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /des na sher phyin gyi phan yon ston pa'i skabs su rjod byed kyi sher phyin gyi dbang du mdzad pa ltar mang du snang yang*/ don la ni lam 'bras gnyis dang las sher phyin gyi phan yon la gtso bor dgongs so/ /gzhung de dag gis ni rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i dang po theg chen sems bskyed spyir bstan te dbye ba nyer gnyis dngos su ma bshad kyang*/ zla stobs kyis bsdus nas bstan par bya dgos te/ yum rgyas 'bring gnyis na sems bskyed nyer gnyis po re re la'ang mdo re snang la/ brgyad stong pa las ni dbye ba ston pa zur du mi 'byung ngo*/ /'di dag mngon rtogs rgyan dang sbyor na/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes sogs dang sbyor ro/ /yum rgyas 'bring gnyis na sems bskyed mtshon byed kyi chos gnyis pa gdams ngag bcu ston pa'i tshig so sor 'byung la/

brgyad stong pa las so sor mi 'byung yang thun mong du spyir gsungs shing*/ sdud pa 'dir yang gang la shes rab pha rol phyin mchog mi dmigs shing*/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bsdus nas spy-ir bstan te/ de yang sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog gi don ni par mi dmigs shing*/ gang spyod pa po byang chub sems dpa' yang don dam par mi dmigs la/ spyod byed byang chub kyi sems yang don dam par mi dmigs te rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes bstan pa'i tshe/ de skad thos nas de'i don mi shes pa'i rmongs pa med cing*/ yid mi skrag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni bde bar gshegs pa'i shes rab kyi phar phyin la spyod par 'jog go /'dir sngar bshad pa'i byang chub sems de nyid stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bsgom dgos so zhes ston pa ste/ slob dpon gyis 'dis stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i gdams ngag ston par bshad do/ /de nas chos gsum pa sbyor lam ni yum rgyas 'bring gnyis na sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi po re re la'ang chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum dang sbyar ba'i mdo tshan so sor yod la/ brgyad stong pa nas so sor phye yang cung zad bsdus te gsungs shing*/ 'dir yang gzugs med tshor ba med cing 'du shes sems pa med/ ces sogs tshigs bcad 'ga' zhig gis drod sogs bzhi so sor phye ba tsam mdzad do/ /'di dag gi tshig don bsdus te brjod na/ sbyor lam bzhi po re re la'ang gsum gsum du phye ba thams cad kyi dmigs pa ni bden pa bzhi dang de'i rnam pa bcu drug rnams yin la/ rang gi rnam pa dngos ni thams cad kyang bden stong gi rnam pa can no/ /thog mar sbyor lam drod kyi dmigs rnam ni/ phung po lnga'i gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed sems pa rnams don dam par med cing*/

de la rnam par shes pa'i gnas dmigs pa ni don dam par rdul tsam yang yod pa min la/ drod la gnas pa de dmigs pa'i chos kun la bden zhen gyis mi gnas te/ de ltar gnas par med par spyod cing bden zhen gyis yongs su bzung bar byed pa med na bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sbyor lam rtse mo'i dmigs rnam ni/ ji ltar te dper na mu stegs kun tu rgyu ba phreng can des bdag tu lta zhing rang gi lam tsam gyis mi grol bar shes pa yi sgo nas/ phyis bstan pa 'di la zhugs nas rigs pas phung po lnga rnam par dpyad nas bshig cing don dam par dmigs pa med pa'i phung po rnams par 'jig pa ste med par rtogs pa'i blo 'byung ba ltar/ sbyor lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig de ltar don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas gzugs sogs kyi chos kun don dam pa mi dmigs par shes pa na/ zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi rig pa ste mi gnas pa de'i tshe byang sems de ni sher phyin la gnas pa'o/ /yang 'di ltar gzugs zhes bya ba 'di dang shes rab 'di ni ngo bo don dam pa gang yin/ 'di su yi yin/ rgyu gang las byung ba yin zhes pa lta bu'i rigs pa yang dag gis phung sogs kyi chos 'di thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin du rtog cing dpyod do/ /de ltar chos kun la nye bar brtags nas stong par mthong ba na sems zhum pa med cing skrag pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang nye ba yin te de myur du 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sbyor lam bzod pa ni/ gal te gzugs sogs bden pas stong pa'i tshul de mi shes bzhin du/ gzugs su bden zhen gyi 'du shes 'byung zhing tshor ba dang 'du byed sems pa dang rnam shes kyi phung po la bden zhen gyis spyod par byed na mi rung zhing*/ phung po 'di rnams bden pas stong snyam du yang bden zhen gyis rtog cing dpyod na'ang*/

byang chub sems dpa' de ni bden 'dzin gyi mtshan ma la spyod pa yin pas/ don dam par skye ba med pa'i gnas la dad pa min no/ /de ni phung po la bden zhen mi rung bar ma zad/ phung po bden stong la'ang bden zhen mi rung bar ston pa'o/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' gang zhing gzugs sogs phung po lnga la bden zhen gyis mi rtog mi spyod cing*/ don dam par ni dmigs pa ci la'ang gnas pa med par spyod pa de ni tha snyad du bden stong la spyod ces bya yang*/ der spyod ces bya bar don dam par mi dmigs par spyod na shes rab brtan pa yin la/ de ni don dam par skye ba med par rtogs pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhi ba mchog la reg pa yin no/ /sbyor lam chos mchog ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig phung sogs don dam par med pa'i don la de ltar rtse gcig tu gnas pa de'i tshe/ 'dir bdag ni ting nge 'dzin zhi ba chos mchog la gnas pa ste/ de ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byang chub tu lung bstan pa yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin de la mnyam par bzhag pa na bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am/ de las langs so zhes snyam pa'i bden zhen gyi rlom sems med do/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na/ phung sogs kyi chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin gyis stong par yongs su shes nas rtse gcig tu sgom pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar spyod pa de ni bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i chos mchog gi shes rab la spyod cing*/ des ni bden zhen gyis spyod pa med par spyod pa yin par rab tu shes pa'i phyir na/ chos gang la spyod pa de yang don dam par dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ don dam par grub pa'i chos gang yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ltar spyod pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /de dag gis sbyor lam bzhi'i dmigs pa dang rnam pa so sor bstan nas chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba shugs la 'phangs so/

/'di dag ni mngon rtogs rgyan dang sbyor na dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang sbyor dgos so/ /de nas sbyor lam bzhi'i spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi ni/ gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis ston te/ dang po gzung rtog gnyis las nyon mongs gzung rtog ni nyon mongs phyogs kyi chos dang*/ rnam byang gzung rtog ni rnam byang phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas gzung byar bden par 'dzin pa zhig ste/ chos gang zhig so skye la bden par snang ba ltar yod pa ma yin pa'i de ni bden par med ces bya la/ byis pa so so skye bo rnams kyis ni gzung bya'i chos de rnams la bden par brtags shing zhen nas/ bden par yod pa dang tha snyad du med par gzung ngo*/ /de lta bu'i yod pa dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis po yang don dam par med pa'i chos yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gis tshul 'di legs par shes na 'khor ba las 'byung zhing thar ro/ /gnyis pa 'dzin rtog gnyis las rdzas 'dzin ni rjes yod dang*/ btags 'dzin ni btags yod kyi chos la dmigs nas 'dzin byed dang*/ 'dzin pa por bden par zhen pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' gang phung po lnga po 'di dag dang*/ skyes bu dang de'i blo la sogs pa rnams ni bden par snang yang bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma dang 'dra bar shes shing*/ skyes bu sgyu ma lta bu dang phung po yang kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu yin pas de dag gi bden stong dang de gnyis ngo bo tha dad pa'i gzhan dang gzhan du mi byed de/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i chos la 'dzin pa po dang 'dzin byed du zhen pa sna tshogs pa'i 'du shes dang bral zhing nye bar zhi ba la spyod pa 'di ni/ lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /'di dag gis sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi'i spang bya'i gtso bo shes sgrib kun btags mngon 'gyur ba bzhi ston cing*/

rgyas 'bring gnyis na rtog pa'i dbye ba bcu drug la mdo tshan re yod kyang*/ brgyad stong pa dang 'dir ni bsdus nas bshad do/ /'di dag ni mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /sbyaur lam pa'i yongs 'dzin ni/ dge ba'i bshes dang ldan zhing zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis ston te/ phyi ma ni theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ldan cing*/ nang du zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dang snying rje chen po sogs dang ldan par gyur pa des ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyi yum sher phyin thos na yid skrag par yong ye mi 'gyur la/ gzhan gang zhig sdig pa'i grogs dang ldan zhing gzhan gyi dbang du song ba'i dṛng 'jog pa de ni/ yum 'di nyan pa'i snod du mi rung ste de ni stong pa nyid kyi chos thos na skrag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ni/ dper na rdza'i snod so ma btang ba'i nang du chu 'chu na des zhig par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /yongs 'dzin 'di rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum na rgyas so/ /'di mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems mi 'god pa nyid la sogs/ /rkang pa bzhis 'chad do/ /bzhi pa theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa gnyis ka thun mong du ci phyir 'di ni zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis ston te/ dang po 'di la rgyas 'bring gnyis na sgrub pa'i rten bcu gsum ston pa'i mdo tshan bcu gsum yod kyang*/ brgyad stong dang 'dir yang bsdus te ston pas/ 'di'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis rigs ston te/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir byang sems 'di la ni sems dpa' zhes bya zhe na/ sgrib gnyis kyi chags pa gcod par byed cing*/ chos kun la bden zhen gyis chags pa de zad par 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya zhing*/ de'i rgyud kyi sems bden stong la sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs zhes bya ste/ theg chen sgrub pas de la dmigs nas bsgoms pas gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/

/'di ni rgyan las/ rtog pa yi ni chos drug dang*/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis na dmigs pa bcu gcig la mdo tshad re yod la/ brgyad stong dang 'dir yang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyi zhes sogs rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyis bsdus nas ston te/ rgyu mtshan snga ma dang der ma zad/ rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub chags pa med par gyur pa rnam mkhyen don du gnyer ba la reg pa'i rgyu mtshan des na gang zag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming thos po zhes byang chub sems dpa'i sgra don bshad pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa rnams 'phangs so/ /'di ni rgyan las/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /drug pa ched du bya ba ni/ yum gsum ka na mdo tshan gsum re yod la/ 'dir ni ci phyir don zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis bsdus nas ston te/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na byang chub sems dpa' de la ni sems dpa' chen po zhes bya zhe na/ sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i gtso bo mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ sems can khams kyi lta ngan sna tshogs rnams bcod par 'dod pa de'i phyir na sems dpa' chen po zhes brjod pa ste snga mas sems chen po dang*/ phyi mas spong ba chen po gnyis dngos su bstan nas rtogs pa chen po shugs kyis 'phangs so/ /'di ni rgyan las/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang*/ / zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis 'chad do/ /mdor na rang don du byang chub don du gnyer bas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ gzhan don du de don du gnyer bas sems dpa' chen po zhes bya ba'o/ /bdun pa go sgrub ni/ yum rgyas 'bring gnyis na go sgrub so drug so sor ston pa'i mdo tshig mang la/ brgyad stong par bsdus nas bstan cing*/ 'dir yang gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis bsdus so/ /de yang phyin drug las mtshon tsam ni/ sbyin pa gtong ba po chen po dang*/

blo shes rab che ba dang*/ mthu che ba dang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyi theg pa chen po'i lam mchog phyin drug la zhugs pa ni go cha'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o/ /'di ni rgyan las/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /brgyad pa 'jug sgrub ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis na rgyas shing brgyad stong par mdo tsam bstan la/ 'dir yang go cha chen po bgos shing sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis 'jug sgrub dgu po bsdus so/ /de yang mi mthun phyogs kyis mi tshugs pa'i phyir du go cha'i sgrub pa chen po nyams su blangs nas go char bgos shing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul ba'i sgo nas theg chen du 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na yang sems dpa' chen po zhes rab tu brjod do/ /'di ni rgyan las/ bsam gtan gzugs med sogs kyis 'chad do/ /dgu pa tshogs sgrub ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis na mdo tshan mang po zhig gis ston cing*/ brgyad stong par tshogs sgrub bcu bdun gyi ngo bo tsam bshad la/ 'dir ni dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis sogs tshigs bcad lngas bsdus so/ /de yang dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis lam gyi bzhi mdor rde'u shing bu sogs rta glang sogs su sprul byas te/ skye bo phal cher mang po sprul nas de dag gcig gis gcig gi mgo mang po bye ba sogs kyi grangs lta bu gcod par byed pa'i sgyu bstan kyang*/ don la ni sems can gcig kyang bsad pa med cing de'i tshe gsad bya de dag snang ba ltar ma grub bzhin du gsod pa ltar snang ngo*/ /dpe de ci 'dra ba de ltar byang chub sems dpas kyang 'gro ba 'di kun bden par snang yang snang ba ltar ma grub pa sbrul pa dang 'dra bar bar tu shes nas/ nyon mongs pa sogs kha na ma tho ba la 'jigs pa med do/ /gzugs dang 'du shes dang tshor ba dang sems pa 'du byed dag dang rnam par shes pa rnams ni don dam par bden 'dzin dang las nyon gyis ma bcings shing ma grol te/

don dam par yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar gzugs sogs kyi chos thams cad kyang don dam par rang bzhin gyis stong par shes pa'i sgo nas tha snyad du byang chub sgrub pa la 'jug go /de'i tshe ci yang mi 'dug go snyam du zhum pa'i sems med pa dgos te/ don dam par ci yang med kyang tha snyad tsam du yod pa'i phyir ro/ de ltar shes pa 'di ni gang zag dam pa rnams kyi spyod pa'i go cha mchog go /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir sgrub pa 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po'i lam zhes bya zhe na/ lam de la byang sems gang zhon pa ste gnas nas sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la zlo ba ste 'god par byed pa'i sgo nas so/ /de lta bu'i theg pa 'di ni rgya che ba nam mkha' dang 'dra zhing byang chub sems dpa' rnams gnas pa'i gzhal med khang chen lta bu dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dga' ba dang skyid pa dang bde ba rnams mngon par thos par byed pa'i phyir theg pa'i mchog go /theg pa 'di la byang sems gang zhig zhon nas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro yang shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su 'gro bar dmigs su med cing*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das par 'gro bar gsungs pa de yang don dam par der 'gro bar mi dmigs so/ /dper na me 'bar ba shi ba na me de ni phyogs gang du 'gro rgyu med pa bzhin no/ /rgyu mtshan des na shes rab kyi stobs kyis rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa log cing spangs pa de la ni mya ngan las 'das pa yin zhes rab tu brjod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni sngon gyi mtha' rgyu dang phyi ma'i mtha' 'bras bu dang*/ da ltar byung ba rang gi ngo bo gsum ka don dam par mi dmigs par shes pa'i phyir dus gsum gyi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis gang dag pa de ni 'dus ma byas spros bral yin pa'i phyir rnam rtog gi spros pa med do/ /de ltar shes shing gnas pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog la spyod pa yin no/

/rgyan las sa'i tshogs logs su rgyas par bshad kyang de dag ni tshogs kyi sgrub par 'dus pas 'dir gsal bar ma phye zhing*/ de bzhin du gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyang logs su ma gsungs so/ /'di ni rgyan las/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ni/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum na mdo tshan mang po zhig 'byung yang*/ 'dir nges 'byung sgrub pa brgyad bsdus te ston pa ni/ byang chub sems mkhas rig pa zhes pa nas dang po'i 'jug gi bar tshigs bcad lngas bsdus so/ /de yang byang chub sems dpa' mkhas shing don rig pas dag sa thob pa gang gi dus kyi tshe/ dngos po thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par rnam par shes shing bsams te 'di ltar spyod par byed cing*/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed kyang sems can du bden pa'i 'du shes 'byung ba med pa 'di ni lam sher phyin mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /de lta ma yin par gal te sems can du bden pa'i 'du shes dang de'i sdug bsngal la bden pa'i 'du shes skyed cing*/ 'gro ba sems can rnams kyi don bya zhing sdug bsngal spang bar bya'o snyam du bdag dang sems can du bden par yongs su rtog na byang chub sems dpa' des de ltar rtog pa 'di ni sher phyin mchog la spyod pa ma yin no/ /des na bdag ni phung po lnga min zhing phung po yang bdag min la/ de las ngo bo tha dad pa'i bdag zhig logs su yod dam med snyam du rigs pa yang dag gis btsal na yod par mi rnyed kyang*/ ma brtags ma dpyad par bdag tha snyad tsam du 'jog tshul shes par bya zhing*/ mdor na bdag ni phung po'i cha shas tshogs pa la btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang rang gi cha shas la brten nas btags pa tsam ma gtogs rang dbang du ma grub ste/ bdag ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar sems can thams cad shes shing sems can thams cad ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar phyi nang gi chos gzhan kun bden par med pa'i tshul shes nas/

don dam par skye ba med pa dang tha snyad du skye ba gnyis ka la bden zhen gyis mi rtog pa 'di ni sher phyin mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /'jig rten dag na 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni tshor ba'o zhes sogs chos rnams la ming gis ji snyed cig yongs su brjod cing tha snyad byas pa de kun la skye ba dang skye ba las yang dag 'das pa gnyis ka'i bden zhen spangs nas/ ye shes kun las mthar thug gi ye shes 'chi ba med pa dang skyon kun spangs pa'i dam pa yon tan gzhal du med pa de 'thob par 'gyur ba de'i phyir 'di ni sher phyin la spyod ces bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig the tshom gyi dogs pa med par de ltar spyaud pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan cing*/ de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden stong mnyam pa nyid la gnas par shes par bya'o/ /tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas chos rnams don dam par rang bzhin med par mngon sum du yongs su shes par gyur pa 'di ni/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog la spyod pa yin zhes bya'o/ /'di ni rgyan las/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ / 'dir bshad pa'i sgrub pa bzhi'i dang pau go sgrub ni tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar dang*/ 'jug sgrub ni sbyor lam nas de'i bar dang*/ tshogs sgrub ni de ltar yin la/ nges 'byung sgrub pa ni dag pa sa gsum kho nar yod do/ /chos bcu ni rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*/ /nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*/ /sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*/ /dmigs pa dag dang ched dag dang*/ /go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*/ / tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams/ /thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de rnams la rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos su bshad pa ni yul gyis yul can mtshon pa yin te/

chos bcu po rnam mkhyen du bgrod pa'i thabs su rnam mkhyen nyid kyis gzigs tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag ni rgyas par bshad na ches mang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir 'brir ma lang pas de tsam zhig bkod do/ /'on kyang gzhung gi gcod 'tshams la slob dpon seng bzang dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis cung zad mi 'dra ba re 'byung yang 'dir slob dpon nyid kyi bzhed pa dang mthun par byas so// //skabs gnyis pas lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos rnams ston te/ de la bcu gcig yod kyang dang po lam shes kyi yan lag ni rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum ka na 'byung yang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis ni 'dir zla stobs kyis bsdus nas dngos su mi 'chad par nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun dang bcas pa 'chad cing*/ de yang gang zhig gzugs la mi gnas tshor la mi gnas shing*/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gsum gsungs zhes bzhed par snang yang*/ slob dpon seng bzang gis tshig bcad dang pos lam shes kyi yan lag bstan par bshad pa ltar bya ste/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gzugs la bden zhen gyis mi gnas shing*/ de bzhin du gang zhig tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed sems pa dang rnam shes la bden zhen gyis mi gnas so/ /de ltar bden zhen gyis mi gnas par bden stong du rtogs pa de ni chos nyid la gnas pa ste/ 'di ni sher phyin mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /'dir bden zhen gyis mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed pa bcom pa'i sgo nas rten ston par bshad do/ /de ltar 'di ni rgyan las/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi don du 'chad dgos so/ /rgyas 'bring gnyis na nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi skor la mdo tshig mang la/ brgyad stong na bsdus shing 'dir ni/ rtag dang mi rtag sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun bzhi dang bcas pa bsdus nas ston te/

de yang bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ sdug bsngal bden pas mtshon te rtag pa dang mi rtag pa dang bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ sdug mi sdug gnyis dang*/ bdag dang bdag med pa gnyis dang*/ bden pa gzhan gyi de bzhin nyid dang de bzhin du don gzhan gyis stong pa dang*/ 'bras bu 'gog bden thob pa dang*/ dgra bcom thob pa'i sa la bden zhen gyis mi gnas shing*/ rang rgyal dang de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang bden zhen gyis mi gnas so/ /mthun dpe ji ltar na 'dren pa sangs rgyas ni 'dus ma byas kyi khams dang 'dus byas kyi khams la yang bden zhen gyis mi gnas shing*/ gnas pa med pa'i tshul gyis spyaud par mdzad pa de ltar byang chub sems dpa' yang dmigs pa'i gnas rnams la ni bden zhen gyis gnas pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas par byed do/ /de lta bu'i gnas pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa gang yin pa 'di ni rgyal bas legs par gnas pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /'dir dngos su bstan pa'i nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ni rnam pa bcu drug rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam dang de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun bzhi po yang dag rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam mo/ /'di ni rgyan las/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ston pa'i sngon du rang rgyal gyi lam de nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags tshul zhig yum gsum dang rgyan las kyang 'byung mod/ 'dir de dngos su mi 'chad par zlas bsdus te ston cing*/ gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar zhes sogs tshigs bcad lngas rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes rgyu sbyor lam bzhi dang bcas pa so sor ma phye bar 'chad la/ yum gsum dang rgyan las ni sbyor lam bzhi so sor phye nas 'chad do/ /don gnyer can gang dag bde bar gshegs pa'i nyan thos dang dgra bcom du 'gyur bar bya snyam pa dang*/

rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin du chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar 'dod pa de dag gis ni/ chos la nges sems zab mo rtogs pa'i bzod pa 'di la brten dgos te/ ma brten na 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung nas de thob par mi nus pa'i phyir te/ dper na rgya mtsho'i nang du lhung ba'i skyes bus rgya mtsho'i pha rol dang tshu rol gang du 'gro ba'i 'gro ngogs mi shes shing mi mthong ba bzhin no/ /su zhig chos ji ltar 'chad pa dang*/ chos nyan pa dang*/ bshad bya'i chos gang yin pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu bzhi thob pa dang*/ rkyen rgyal rang sangs rgyas dang*/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi mgon po sangs rgyas kyi myang 'das sogs mkhas pa blo gsal bas thob pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thar pa gang yin pa de kun kyang*/ tha snyad du btags shing kun rdzob tu yod par 'jog gi don dam par med cing bden stong sgyu ma lta bur de bzhin gshegs pas bstan to/ /skabs 'dir yum gsum las kyang de ltar bshad cing de la dgos pa yod de/ bden par grub na bsgyur du mi rung bas thob bya thob byed sogs bya byed thams cad mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bden stong sgyu ma lta bu 'di thos na gzhan blo chung ba dag 'di ci lta bu zhig snyam ste skrag par 'gyur ba 'ong yang*/ gang zag bzhi po 'di dag ni tshul te lta bu thos na yid mi skrag ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rgyal sras bden pa bzhi'i rnam dbye la mkhas pa dang*/ byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i lam thob pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa nyon mongs pa'i dri ma bsam cing som nyi spangs pa gsum dang*/ bzhi pa ni stong nyid ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa rnams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas shing don rig pa gang de ltar shes shing spyod pa ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i sa la mi slob cing rkyen rtog rang rgyal gyi sa la mi slob pa min zhes don du mi gnyer te/

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa'i ched du sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rjes su slob cing don du gnyer ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du slob par byed cing dman pa'i byang chub kyi ched du mi slob la/ phyi ma ltar mi slob cing snga ma ltar slob par byed pa ni slob tshul phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /byang sems kyis sdug bden gyi gzugs sogs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ yongs su nyams shing rgud pa dang gces par yongs su gzung ba'i phyir slob pa ma yin te/ der ma zad/ chos gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag kyang bden zhen gyis yongs su gzung ba'i phyir mi slob par slob cing*/ de ltar slob par byed na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid don du gnyer ba'i blos kyang yongs su zin la/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba gang yin pa 'di ni yon tan gong ma don gnyer la dga' ba'i slob tshul yin no/ /'di ni rgyan las/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas theg chen gyi mthong lam ni/ yum gsum ka na mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad kyi mdo tshig mang du 'byung zhing*/ 'dir ni gzugs ni shes rab ma yin gzugs la shes rab med/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad bzhis bsdus so/ /de yang gzugs la mtshon na gzugs ni rang nyid bden stong du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang gcig ma yin zhing*/ gzugs la ni shes rab de nyid med do/ /de bzhin du rnam shes dang 'du shes dang tshor ba dang sems pa 'du byed 'di dag ni shes rab de ma yin la/ 'di dag la yang shes rab de brten pa'i tshul gyis so sor gnas pa med do/ /bden bzhi sogs kyi rang bzhin bden stong 'di ni nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa'i dgag bya rnam par bcad tsam ste ngo bo tha dad du med do/ /de yang dmigs pa sdug bden rnams kyi rang bzhin bden stong de ni pha mtha' med par gnas shing*/ sems can 'byung ba'i rgyu kun 'byung gi rang bzhin gang yin pa de yang pha mthar med la/

nam mkha'i khams lta bu'i 'gog bden gyi rang bzhin de yang pha mtha' med cing*/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i shes rab lam bden gyi rang bzhin de yang pha mtha' med do/ /de ni slob dpon ltar bden bzhi dang sbyar yang de dang ma sbyar bar spyir bshad du'ang rung ngo*/ /gzugs sogs la de dang de'i 'du shes skye ba ni tshu rol mthong ba'i so skye'i dbang du mdzad nas 'dren pa sangs rgyas kyis tha snyad tsam du yongs su bsgrags pa yin la/ sna tshogs pa'i 'du shes de rigs pas rnam par bshig cing bkag nas bden stong du bsgoms pas/ nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i spong ba 'gog bden thob cing 'khor ba'i pha rol tu 'gro'o/ /byang sems gang dag bden pa'i 'du shes mngon 'gyur ba dang bral ba'i lam 'di ni rjes su thob pa de dag spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob nas ston pa'i bka' bzhin du sgrub pa la gnas so/ /gal te ston pas kyang ni gad+gā'i bye ma snyed kyi bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs te sems can zhes pa'i sgra yongs su bsgrags kyang*/ sems can rnams gzod nas gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis dag pas don dam par sems can zhig gsar du skye bar ga la 'gyur snyam du shes pa 'di ni shes phyir mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /sems can bzod nas dag pa ni sems can rnams dang po skyes tsam nas bden pas stong pa yin gyi/ bden stong du gsar byung min ces pa'o/ /de dag gis mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug po bsdus nas bstan te/ /'di ni rgyan las/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa ni/ yum gsum ka na rgyas shing*/ 'dir gang tshe nga ni pha rol phyin pa'i mchog 'di dang*/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bsdus so/ /de yang dus gang gi tshe sgom lam sgom pa po nga ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog 'di dang mthun par smra zhing spyod par gyur pa de'i tshe/

sngon gyi skyes mchog sangs rgyas kyis khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas ming 'di zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes nga lung bstan par gyur ces rgyal bas de skad gsungs so/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gang la 'jig rten gyi mgon po rgyal sras sbyod pa'i gzhung don 'di ni/ byang sems gang zhig gus par byas shing 'dzin pa dang kun chub pa sogs byed pa de la ni/ phyi'i dug dang mtshon dang me dang chus mi tshugs shing*/ bdud dngos dang bdud rigs kyi phyogs rnams kyis glags kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /byed pa bcu gcig po 'di ni rgyan las/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la/ / zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas mos pa sgom lam ni/ yum gsum ka na dbye ba gsum dang dgu dang nyer bdun so sor ston pa'i mdo tshan yod cing*/ 'dir ni la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad mang po zhig gis cung zad spros nas 'chad do/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sogs la las bde bar gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yi ring bsrel snying po can gyi mchod rten ni/ gser dngul byi ru mu tig sogs rin po che sna bdun las byas shing me tog sogs kyis rtag tu mchod par byed la/ de yang mchod rten gcig tsam zhig ma yin par bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gi grangs ni/ gad+gā'i klung gi bye ba snyed kyis bye ba phrag stong gi zhing kun bkang ste/ de ltar yongs su brtag pa ste dbye ba yongs su bzung ba'i zhing rnams grangs bye ba mtha' yas pa na/ sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams can kyis las gzhan mi byed par lha'i me tog dang bdug spos rab mchog dang dri'i byugs pas/ snga dro gung phyi dro'i dus gsum du lan gcig tsam ma yin par bskal ba'am/ de bas kyang lhag par mchod rten de rnams la gus pas mchod na bsod nams che mod/ de las kyang byang sems gang zhig sher phyin gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'gyur ba/

bde bar gshegs pa'i yum 'di glegs bam la bris te tshig don yid la 'chang zhing me tog dang byug pas bsti stang bkur sti byed par gyur na/ sngar bshad pa lta bu'i mchod rten byas shing mchod pa'i bsod nams kyis ni/ bsod nams 'di'i char yang mi phod na mnyam pa ga la 'ong zhes pa ni gtso bor sgom lam gyi sher phyin la dgongs so/ /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rig sngags chen po yin te/ sems can gyi khams mang po'i mya ngan dang sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi chos kun zhi bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa dang gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i mgon po rnams kyang*/ rig sngags sher phyin 'di la bslabs nas sdug bsngal gyi nad zhi bar mdzad pa'i rgyal po bla na med par gyur to/ /byang sems gang dag gzhan la phan pa dang snying brtser bcas par sngar spyad pa dang*/ da lta spyod pa de dag kun kyang rig sngags sher phyin 'di la bslabs nas mkhas pa de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la reg par 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas lam bden nam zag bcas kyi bde ba dang 'dus ma byas zag med myang 'das kyi bde ba gang yin pa'i bde ba de kun ni/ sher phyin 'di las byung bar rig par bya'o/ /dper na 'jig rten na gro nas sogs sa bon sna tshogs btab nas de dag gi 'bras bu sa la gnas te 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag ni/ rgyu rkyain gyi tshogs pa tshang zhing rnyed nas 'bras bu rnam pa mang po'i gzugs dag rnam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dpe de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan lnga dang bcas pa'i byang chub kyi yon tan ji snyed de dag kun kyang sher phyin 'di las gong 'phel du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dpe gzhan yang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po phyogs su 'gro ba'i skabs su/ lam gang nas rgyal po rtag tu 'gro ba'i lam de nyid nas ni 'khor lo rin po che la sogs pa'i rin chen bdun dang*/

dmag gi dpung tshogs kun kyang 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du lam gang nas rgyal ba'i sher phyin 'di 'gro ba'i lam de nyid nas ni/ theg pa chen po'i yon tan gyi chos kun 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal bas mkhyen bzhin du lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis mos pa sgom lam gyi phan yon las brtsams te dris pa'i dri ba de'i lan brgya byin gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dris pa'i dri ba de gnyis kyi nang nas gal te gad+gā'i bye ma snyed kyi zhing kun sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gyur la/ zhing de kun kyang rgyal ba'i ring bsrel gyis byur bur gang zhing gtams par gyur kyang*/ de dang sher phyin 'di gnyis kyi nang nas gang len 'doms su bcug na bdag gis ni sher phyin 'di nyid len par byed do/ /rgyu mtshan ci slad ce na sku gdung ring bsrel de rnams la bdag mi gus pa ma lags mod kyi/ 'on kyang sku gdung de dag la mchod pa ni de dag sher phyin gyis yongs su bsgos pa ste zin pa'i dbang gis mchod par bgyid pa lags so/ /dper na rgyal po la brten pa'i mi blon po lta bu ni gzhan gyis bkur bsti dang rim gro byed pa thob pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel la mchod pa thob pa de ni sher phyin gyis zin cing de la brten pa'i dbang ngo*/ /yang dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yon tan kun dang ldan pa rin thang gi tshad gzhal du med pa de ni/ gab tshe ste snod gang du stsal ba'am bzhag pa'i snod de ni phyag bgyi bar 'os shing*/ rin po che de phyung bar gyur kyang 'jog pa'i gab tshe snod de la ni dga' bar bgyid de/ snod la dga' ba 'byung ba'i yon tan de dag ni nor bu rin po che de yi lags so/ /dpe de bzhin du sher phyin gyis zin pa'i yon tan phan yon gyis rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das kyang ring bsrel la mchod pa brnyes so/

/de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig rgyal ba'i yon tan 'dzin cing thob par 'dod pa'am 'tshal pa des ni/ sher phyin 'di ni 'bri 'don bsam bsgom gyis blang bar bya ste de ltar byas na byang sems 'di ni gnod pa thams cad dang*/ las nyon kun las thar pa'i myang 'das thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de dag gis gzhan don mos pa sgom lam bstan nas rang don dang gnyis don mos pa sgom lam ni/ sbyin pa'i skabs dang sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i zin byed ni shes rab ste/ tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /sher phyin 'di ni sbyin sogs dge ba'i chos gzhan gong 'phel du byed pa'i gzhi chud mi gson pa'i phyir yongs su 'dzin pa yin no/ /sher phyin 'di ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos rnams thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu 'gyur bar byed pa'i tshul gcig tu ston par byed pa'o/ /dper na 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na shing rnams ni grangs bye ba stong la sogs pa dang*/ dbyibs dang kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnam pa du ma gzugs mang ba de dag gi grib ma la khyad par med de/ shing mi 'dra yang de dag gi grib ma la grib mar gyur pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su brjod pa ma gtogs par/ grib ma la shing ltar dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs med cing bye brag khyad par yod pa ma yin no/ /dpe de bzhin du rgyal ba'i phar phyin dang po lnga po 'di dag kyang ngo bo dang byed las tha dad pa yod kyang*/ sher phyin 'dis zin na ni lnga po des kyang sher phyin gyi ming nyid 'thob par 'gyur zhing*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa'i phyir du yongs su bsngos par byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam zhes bya bar khyad par med par phar phyin drug po 'di kun ro gcig ste byed las sam rang bzhin gcig par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis mos pa sgom lam chung 'bring chen po dgu bstan nas/

bcos ma'i gzugs brnyan spong ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kha cig gal te bden med kyi don rab tu mi shes bzhin du/ gzugs tshor sogs phung po lnga ni mi rtag pa'o zhes bden par bcos te yongs su ston par byed na/ de ni sher phyin bcos ma ston pa la spyod pa ste phung po lnga bden pas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mkhas pas ni nam yang bden grub tu bzung nas phung sogs kyi chos rnams mi rtag cing 'jig par ston par mi byed de/ bden par grub na 'jig par mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na ji ltar bya snyam na/ byang chub sems dpa' chos gang la mnyam par bzhag pa na gzugs rang bzhin gyis dmigs pa min pa sogs phung po lnga rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs la/ phung sogs kyi chos don dam par rang bzhin gyis skye ba med par stong pa'i tshul du rab tu shes na/ de ltar shes pa 'di ni sher phyin la spyod pa yin no/ /bsdu na 'dus byas thams cad tha snyad du skye yang rkyen la rag las pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis skye bas stong zhes pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa'o/ /de nas mos pa sgom lam la bstod pa dang bkur ba dang bsngags pa gsum po re re la dgu dgur phye nas 'chad pa la/ dper na gang zag la las gad+gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi zhing rnams na sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de kun kyang*/ nyon mongs btul ba'i nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang la bkod na bsod nams shin tu che yang*/ de las gang gis sher phy-in 'di yi ger bris te sems can byang chub sems dpa' mchog la glegs bam sbyin pa byin na de ni bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir zhe na smra mchog sangs rgyas de dag ni sher phyin 'dir bslabs nas sangs rgyas te/ /chos rnams mtha' dag rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du sher phyin gyi gzhung 'dir ston par byed cing*/ gdul byas de thos pas nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la myur du reg pa ste thob par 'gyur ro/

/yang dper na 'jig rten na sa bon btab nas myu gu sngon po 'byung ba med par de'i sdong po 'byung ba yang yong ye med cing*/ de med na de la yal ga dang 'dab ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu ga la 'byung ste/ mi 'byung ngo*/ /de bzhin du myu gu lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba med na sdong bu lta bu'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas 'byung ba 'jig rten du yong ye med la/ de med na 'bras bu lta bu'i brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang nyan thos sogs kyang 'jig rten du ga la 'byung ste mi 'byung ngo*/ /de ni lha chen rnams dang nyan rang 'jig rten du 'byung ba rnams kyang sangs kyi mthu yin par bstan pa'o/ /yang na dper na/ dus gang gi tshe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed cing shar ba de'i tshe sems can rnams kyis rang rang gi las byed pa la brtson par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ blang dor gyi gnas gsal bar byed nus pa'i mkhas pa gzhan blang dor shes pa'i phyir 'jig rten du byang chub sems dpa' 'byung na/ de'i ye shes kyis ni blang dor bstan nas sems can blang dor shes pa'i yon tan gyi chos dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na ma dros rgya mtsho la klu'i bdag po ma dros pa med na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung 'bab par ga la 'gyur te mi 'gyur zhing*/ chu klung 'bab pa med na me tog dang 'bras bu sogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ der ma zad/ rgya mtsho la yang rin po che'i gzugs mang po dag kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni skabs dang por bshad zin to/ /'di ni rgyan las/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /rjes su yi rang sgom lam ni yum gsum na mdo tshig mang yang*/ 'dir ni 'jig rten 'di na sogs tshigs bcad gnyis tsam gyis bsdus so/ /dper na/ 'jig rten 'di na 'od kyi snang byed me sogs dang*/ srog chags sems can ji snyed yod pa kun gyi ni gzugs snang bar bya ba'i phyir du rang rang gi 'od rnams phyung ba bas/

nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gcig phyung ba ches mchog tu gyur pa ste/ snang byed kyi tshogs gzhan gyi 'od rnams kun gyis ni nyi ma'i 'od kyi cha shas tsam du yang 'gran mi phod do/ /dpe de bzhin du nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi tshogs rnams kyis ji snyed bgyis pa'i sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bsgoms pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bskyed pa'ang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba'i sems gcig gi bsod nams la ni nyan thos tshogs kyi bsod nams phung pos char yang mi phod do/ /'di ni rgyan las/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ / 'dir rgyan dang go rim mi 'dra bar snang ngo*/ /bsngo ba sgom lam ni/ yum gsum ga na mdo tshig shin tu mang la/ 'dir ni/ 'das dus sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad brgyad kyis 'chad de/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig 'das pa'i dus na sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang byung ba dang*/ de lta phyogs bcu'i zhing mang mtha' yas bye ba stong phrag dag na gang bzhugs pa dang*/ dus gang gi tshe yang mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i 'jig rten gyi mgon po rnams kyis/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir du chos ston pa'i dus dang*/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bskyed pa'i dus nas gzung ste/ sangs rgyas 'das te rnam par 'dren pa de rnams kyi dam chos zad cing nub pa'i dus de'i bar du/ rgyal ba de dag gis bsod nams gang bskrun pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos dang sangs rgyas kyi chos gzhan gang yin pa dang*/ gang yang sangs rgyas kyi sras byang sems rnams dang nyan thos slob pa dang mi slob pa dgra bcom pa sogs kyis bskrun pa'i dge ba zag bcas dang zag med rnams gcig tu bsdus nas/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas rjes su yi rang zhing de'i dge ba rnams 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir ni thams cad bsngo'o/

/de ltar yongs su bsngo ba de'i tshe gal te gang gis bsngo ba'i sems la bden pa'i 'du shes dang*/ bsngo ba'i yul byang chub dang*/ gang gi don du bsngo ba'i sems can rnams la bden pa'i 'du shes 'jug par mi bya ste/ de ltar bsngo ba'i 'khor gsum la bden pa'i 'du shes 'jug na 'du shes de'i phyir na bden zhen gyi lta ba gnas shing*/ sems ni bsngo ba'i 'khor gsum la bden zhen gyis chags pa'i dmigs pa yod pa'i skyon gyis/ yongs su bsngos pa de ni dmigs med kyi bsngo bar chud pa ma yin no/ /'o na ji ltar bya zhe na gal te 'di ltar gang bsngau rgyu'i chos 'di rnams ni rang bzhin gyis 'gags pa ste med cing zad pa dang*/ gang du yongs su bsngo ba sangs rgyas kyi byang chub de yang rang bzhin gyis zad pa dang*/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i chos kyis thob bya'i chos gang la tha snyad tsam ma gtogs/ nam yang rang bzhin gyis mi bsngo ba'i tshul shes par gyur na de ltar rab tu shes pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang nas byang chub tu bsngos na ni yongs su bsngos pa dam pa yin no/ /gal te bsngo ba'i 'khor gsum la bden par zhen pa'i mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo tshul rnam dag min la/ ci ste bden 'dzin gy-i mtshan ma med na byang chub tu bsngo ba yin no/ /ji ltar te dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang po za bar byas na phan gnod gnyis ka 'byung ba de dang 'dra bar/ dkar po'i chos bsngo ba'i 'khor gsum la bden zhen gyis dmigs pa la'ang de dang 'dra ba'i skyon yon gnyis ka 'byung ste/ bsngo ba'i ngo bo'i sgo nas 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba 'byung yang bden zhen gyi dbang gis 'khor bar bcings nas mi grol bar rgyas bas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na ji ltar bya snyam na/ de lta bas na 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ba la bslab par bya ste/ dpe ji ltar na dus gsum gyi rgyal ba de dag gis rang gzhan gyi dge ba de dang de mkhyen pa'i dge ba de dag gi rnam pa gang yin pa dang*/

'bras bu 'byung tshul gang yin pa dang*/ rigs dang mtshan nyid gang yin pa'i tshul mngon sum du gzigs shing de la rjes su yi rang bas bsngo ba ci ltar mdzad pa de lta de ltar rjes su yi rang zhing byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /de ltar bsod nams dge ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu bden stong sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo bar byed na ni/ dug med pa'i bsngo tshul sangs rgyas kyi bka' mi spong ba'i bsngo tshul yin te/ rgyal bas gsungs pa bzhin du smra zhing sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /bsngo ba'i skabs 'dir byams pas bshad pa mang ngo*/ /bsngo ba bcu gnyis po 'di ni rgyan las/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de yan gyis zag bcas sgom lam gsum bstan nas/ de nas zag med sgom lam gnyis kyi dang po sgrub pa sgom lam ni/ yum gsum na mdo tshan mang yang*/ 'dir dmus long dmigs bu med pa zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhis bsdus so/ /de yang dper na dmus long dmigs bu long 'khrid med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams ni/ phyogs kyi grong dang grong khyer gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod kyang de'i tshe 'gro sa'i lam yang mi shes na/ phyogs kyi grong dang grong khyer du 'jug nus par ga la 'gyur te mi 'gyur ro/ /dpe de bzhin du sher phyin 'dis zin pa med na mig sher phyin med pa'i sbyin sogs dang po lnga po 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu 'khrid mkhan gyi dmigs bu med pas byang chub de la reg pa ste thob nus pa ma yin no/ /dus gang gi tshe lnga po de sher phyin gyis ni rab tu zin par gyur pa de'i tshe/ phar phyin dang po lngas mig rnyed par gyur cing phar phyin 'di'i ming 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ni dper na lha mi lta bu'i gzugs brnyan bris pa'i ri mo'i las gzhan ni yongs su byas zin kyang*/ de'i mig bris pa med na ji srid mig ma bris pa'i bar de srid du gzugs brnyan mi rdzogs pas yon rngon pa mi 'thob pa bzhin no/

/dus gang gi tshe 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos dang*/ dkar nag dge mi dge'i chos thams cad don dam dpyod pa'i shes rab kyis rnam par bshig nas dpyad cing btsal ba na don dam par grub pa rdul tsam yang mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa de'i tshe/ 'jig rten dag na sher phyin zhes pa'i grangs su 'gro ste dper na nam mkha' ni dgag bya thog reg bkag tsam gyi stong cha la 'jog cing*/ de chos gzhan gang la'ang cung zad kyang ma 'dres par rang dbang gis tha dad du sam gnas pa de dang 'dra'o/ /yang gal te bdag ni rgyal ba'i sher phyin la spyad par bya zhing*/ sems can sdug bsngal gyis reg pas gzir ba khrag khrig mang po rnams sdug bsngal las dgrol bar bya'o snyam du sems shing*/ sems can du bden zhen gyi 'du shes pas yongs su rtog cig dpyod na byang chub sems dpa' 'di ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog la spyod pa ma yin no/ /'di ni rgyan las/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ / ces sogs kyis 'chad do/ /rnam dag sgom lam ni/ yum gsum gyi mdo tshig mang yang*/ 'dir byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis bsdus so/ /de yang byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig sngon sher phyin la spyad cing spyod pa'i tshe phar phyin 'dir spyad pa'i mkhas pa de dag ni/ da lta sher phyin 'di la som nyi med cing 'di thos ma thag tu ston pa dang 'dra ba'i 'du shes skyed par 'gyur te/ byang sems des ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub zhib myur du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /sngon byang chub kyi spyod pa spyod pa'i tshe na ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang po la bsnyen bkun byas kyang*/ da ltar rgyal ba'i sher phyin 'di la ma dad na de'i rkyen gyis 'di thos nas blo chung de yis sher phyir 'di ni spong bar byed de/ 'di spangs nas skyabs med par gyur pa'i sems can de ni mnar med du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/

/rgyu mtshan de lta bas na gal te sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mchog la reg cing thob par 'dod na ni rgyal yum sher phyin 'di la dad par gyis shig dper na tshong pa rin po che'i gling du song nas ni rang gi zong dngos po rnams zad cing*/ rin po che ma thob par lag pa stong par slar yul du log pa lta bur gyur na ni mi rung ngo*/ /'di rnams kyis rnam dag sgom lam dang 'byung ba'i rgyu rnams ston te/ 'di ni rgyan las/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang*/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /rnam dag sgom lam gyi ngo bo ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis na tshig shin tu mang la/ brgyad stong du cung zad bsdus shing*/ 'dir ni gzugs kyi dag pa 'bras bu dag par rig par bya/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis thams cad bsdus nas 'chad do/ /de yang gzugs sogs la dmigs pa'i dri ma rnam par dag pa ni dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu'i ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa yin te/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu rang gi ngo skal gyi dri ma dang bral ba na/ de'i ngo skal gyi spang bya'i dri ma bden 'dzin gyis ni gzugs sogs dag cing*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de'i don ni gzugs sogs la dmigs pa'i dri ma gang spangs pa na de phyin dri ma des gzugs sogs la dmigs pa mi 'byung bas gzugs sogs dri ma des dag pa yin kyang*/ gzugs sogs kyis dri ma de spangs pa ni min no/ /des na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dri mas rnam par dag pa dang*/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu rang gi spang bya'i dri mas rnam par dag pa dang*/gzugs sogs la dmigs pa'i dri mas gzugs sogs rnam par dag pa'i dag pa gsum po de rigs gcig pa yin te/ dper na nam mkha'i khams kyi phyogs mtshams la rigs tha dad pa'i khyad par med par stong cha dang mtshungs pa'i phyir te/

stong cha'i rnam dag la rigs med 'dra ba gnyis su med cing blos gnyis su dbye ba byar med pas mi 'dra bar tha dad par gcad du med pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni rgyan las/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas yum gsum dang rgyan las kyang lam gsum gyi spangs ba'i khyad par dang shin tu rnam dag brtsod spong zhig bshad kyang 'dir dngos su mi 'byung ngo*/ /skabs gsum par gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu 'chad cing*/ de yang yum gsum na lam shes gnyis ston pa'i mdo tshig mang yang*/ 'dir ni dpa' bo gang spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yis/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bsdus so/ /don ni/ dpa' bo byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa gang la spyod pa'i sher phyin srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i lam shes kyi stobs kyis/ las nyon gyis khams gsum du skye ba len pa'i rgyu las nyon las yang dag par 'das shing spangs pa yin la/ 'on kyang las nyon tsam spangs pa'i rnam par grol ba'i zhi mtha' la gnas pa'ang min te/ byang sems des nyon mongs pa spangs shing bsal par gyur kyang snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'dod gzugs kyi gnas su skye ba len par ston par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du las nyon gyi dbang gis rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba rnams med kyang 'chi 'pho byed pa'i tshul yang ston te/ de'i rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i lam shes dang*/ phyi ma gnyis kyis rnying rje'i zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes ston te gzhi shes ba'i sher phyin kyang yin no/ /'di ni rgyan las/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas 'gro ba 'khrul ba sogs tshigs bcad phyed dang gsum gyis skabs 'di'i yum gsum gyi don bsdus nas mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes gnyis 'chad de/ de yang 'gro ba 'di dag ming brjod pa dang gzugs mthong ba sogs la brten nas gzugs sogs bden zhen gyis chags zhing*/

de ltar chags pa'i dbang gis las bsags nas rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyams so/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyis mi mthun phyogs dang*/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes gnyis bsdus nas bstan cing*/ byang chub sems dpas ni 'gro ba 'khrul pa bden 'dzin gyis bcings te 'khor ba de/ dper na ri dwags rgyar chud pa dang 'dra bar shes nas shes rab dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ nam mkha' la bya rgyu ba bzhin du 'khor ba'i gnas su rgyu yang de'i skyon gyis mi gos so/ /spyod pa yongs su dag pa'i byang sems gang zhig gzugs la bden zhen gyis mi spyod cing*/ de bzhin du phung po gzhan bzhi la yang mi spyod na/ de ltar sbyod pa po bden 'dzin gyi chags pa thams cad yongs su spong zhing*/ zhen chags de las rnam par grol te bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi shes rab la spyod pa yin no/ /de ltar spyod pa'i byang sems mkhas shing gsal ba des bden 'dzin gyi chags pa bcad nas chags pa med pa sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro'o zhes pas/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes dang nye ba'i gzhi shes gnyis bsdus nas ston to/ /'di dag gis ni byang sems bsam bzhin du 'khor bar gnas te sems can gyi don byed pa'i khyad chos ston to/ /'di ni rgyan las/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgom pa/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas nyi ma sgra gcan gza' bral sogs rkang pa bzhis yum gsum gyi don bsdus te shes sbyor ba dang de'i mnyam nyid kyi sbyor lam gnyis ston te/ de yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrib byed sgra gcan gza' dang sprin sogs dang bral ba'i tshe 'od lhang nger shar nas 'dug ste mun pa 'joms pa dang*/ me btang na rtswa dang shing dang nags tshal rnams sreg par byed pa bzhin du/ bden bzhi'i chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin gyis dag cing yongs su dag par byang chub sems dpa' sher phyin gyis lta bar byed na/

sbyor lam de lam bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni rgyan las/ gzugs sogs de mi rtogs sogs dang*/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas mthong lam ni yum gsum na tshig mang yang*/ 'dir ni/ byed pa po yang mi dmigs chos kun mi dmigs te/ /zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis mdor bsdus nas ston te/ don ni/ de ltar goms pas lam sgom par byed pa po dang bsgom bya'i mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi chos kun don dam par mi dmigs par gsar du mngon sum du rtogs pa 'di ni/ mthong ba'i lam gyi sher phyin mchog la spyod pa yin no/ /'di ni rgyan las/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /'di'i 'jug tu yum gsum dang rgyan las mkhyen gsum ston pa'i mjug sdud zhig bshad kyang 'dir mi 'byung ngo*/ /de nas skabs bzhi pas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig 'chad cing*/ 'on kyang thog ma'i rnam pa la mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya don gsum yod pa'i rnam pa rnams ni yum gsum na 'chad pa'i mdo tshig mang yang*/ 'dir zlas bsdus nas dngos su mi ston par sbyor ba sgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag nas 'chad de/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes ltar na/ rgyal ba la ni lha rgyal brgya byin gyis zhus pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis rten gyi gang zag dang*/ gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sogs tshigs bcad dgus sbyor ba rnams 'chad pa'i dang po ni/ /rgyas pa'i dbang po la lha'i rgyal po brgya byin gyis zhus pa byang chub sems dpa' sher phyin la spyod pa'i tshe ji ltar brtson zhing spyod ces zhus pa na/ lan du gzugs sogs phung po lnga dang khams sogs kyi chos la don dam par rdul tsam yang med par spyod cing*/ bden zhen gyis mi rtag pa sogs su brtson zhing sbyor bar mi byed de/

phung por mi brtson pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir yang dag par brtson pa yin no/ /'di ni rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gzugs sogs kyi chos 'di rnams ni bden par snang yang*/ bden par ma grub pa sprul pa dang sgyu ma dang 'dra bar thos nas/ tshig don la the tshom dang som nyi med cing slob pa la lhag par phyir zhing sbyor bar byed ba'i sems can de ni/ yun ring po nas theg chen la zhugs par rigs par bya ste/ de ni tshe sngon sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa yin no/ /dper na mi med pa'i dgon pa'i lam ni grong las dpag tshad mang po na yod par zhugs te song ba'i mis ni/ gnag rdzi ste ba lang rdzi bo dang mtshams su yod pa'i nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa rnams mthong na/ 'di dag ni da grong dang grong khyer de dang der thag nye ba'i rtags yin no snyam ste/ dga' ba'i dbugs phyin pa rnyed par gyur cing chom rkun sogs 'jigs pa med par sems so/ /dpe de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yongs su 'tshol ba'i tshe rgyal ba rnams kyi sher phyin 'di ni/ mnyan pa dang sgom par byed pa gang thob pa de ni da bdag sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang nye'o snyam pa'i dga' bas dbugs phyin pa thob par gyur cing*/ dman lam du ltung ba sogs kyi 'jigs pa med par 'gyur te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang rkyen rtog rang rgyal gyi sar ltung ba min cing de las grol ba'i phyir snyam mo/ /yang dper na mi gang zhig rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni ji lta bu yin snyam du blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba de yis ni/ gal te mdun phyogs su shing dang nags tshal dang ri rnams mthong na rgya mtsho ni da dung thag ring snyam la/ ci ste rtags de dag ma mthong na da rgya mtsho chen po dang ni nye bar gyur to snyam ste nye ba de la som nyi med do/

/dpe de ltar byang chub dam pa'i ched du rab tu zhugs nas rgyal ba'i sher phyin 'di nyan par byed pa po rig par bya ste/ des bdag ni rnam par 'dren pa sangs rgyas kyis mngon sum du lung bstan par ma gyur kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub chos kyi sku de ring por mi thogs par bdag gis reg pa ste thob par 'gyur par shes so/ /yar dper na dpyid dus bzang po la btab pa dang ma btab pa'i sdong po dang lo ma rnying pa rnams lhags par gyur na/ yal ga las ring por mi thogs par lo ma dang 'bras bu dang me tog gsar ba rnams bskrun no/ /dpe de bzhin du sher phyin 'di su yi lag tu thob pa de ring por mi thogs par 'dren pa rnams kyis byang chub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku myur du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na bud med sbrum ma gang lto ba na gnas pa'i bu cher song ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen par gyur na/ de ni myur du de'i bu btsa' ba'i dus la bab ces bya ste/ de bzhin du byang sems gang rgyal ba'i sher phyin 'di la nyan sgom gyis dga' ba dang dad pa'i 'dun pa bskyed pa de myur du rgyal ba'i byang chub sbrul ba'i skur rig par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sher phyin mchog la spyod pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ba des ni/ gzugs sogs kyi chos rnams ni 'phel zhing skye ba dang*/ yongs su 'jig cing 'grib pa don dam par mi mthong ngo*/ /byang sems gang zhig dam pa'i chos dang dam pa'i chos ma yin pa dang chos kyi dbyings bden stong kyang don dam par yod par mi mthong zhing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi mtha' la mi reg pa de ni sher phyin la gnas so/ /byang sems gang zhig sher phyin 'dir spyaud pa'i tshe chos gzhan tsam du ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi chos spangs rtogs rnams la bden zhen gyis mi rtog ste/ stobs rnams dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang byang chub zhi ba myang 'das la'ang mi rtog go

/de ltar bden zhen gyis mi rtog pa'i rtog bral la sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs kyis spyod pa 'di ni sher phyin la spyod pa yin no/ /'di dag gis sbyor ba nyi shu po phal cher gsal por bshad cing 'ga' zhig ni mi gsal lo/ /'di ni rgyan las/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas sbyor ba'i skyon yon gnyis ni yum gsum na rgyas shing*/ 'dir ni skyon sngon du btang ste zhu ba ni/ smra ba'i zla ba sangs rgyas la ni rab 'byor zhus/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad bcus 'chad de/ dang po skyon ni/ smra ba'i zla ba sangs rgyas la ni gnas brtan rab 'byor gyis zhus pa/ yon tan dga' ba thob pa'i byang sems rnams kyi sbyor pa'i skyon bar du gcod par gang lags/ lan du ston pas bka' stsal pa sbyor ba'i skyon bar du gcod par 'gyur tshul mang ste/ de las re zhig 'dir cung zad tsam zhig bsdus te yongs su brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal ba'i sher phyin 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang sgom pa'i tshe myur du 'dri sgom 'dod mi 'dod sogs blo'i spobs pa mi 'dra ba tha dad pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa du ma 'byung bar 'gyur zhing*/ rang dang 'gro ba gzhan gyi don gang 'dod pa de ma byas par glog myur du 'jig pa bzhin du/ blo mi brtan par myur du yang yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las te skyon no/ /yang kha cig sher phyin 'di bshad pa'i tshe na som nyi the tshom za bar 'gyur te/ 'di snyam du 'dren pas sher phyin 'dir ni bdag gi ming dang rigs dang gnas sa dang rus kyang longs su ma brjod ces zer zhing*/ de ni yum 'di nyan par mi 'gyur bar slong bar 'gyur te bdud kyi las so/ /yum 'di las sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs legs par bstan pa de ltar mi shes pa de dag gis/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i rtsa ba 'di bor nas ni rmongs pa mi shes pa'i dbang gis yal ga dang 'dam ma lta bu'i nyan rang gi mdo sde tsam 'tshol bar 'gyur ro/

/de yang dper na glang po che rnyed kyang de bor nas glang po che'i rjes tsam zhig ni 'tshol ba ltar/ sher phyin 'di thob nas bor te nyan rang gi theg pa tsam ston pa'i mdo 'tshol ba yang de bzhin no/ / yang dper na la las kha zas ro brgya dang ldan par rnyed la/ zas mchog gzhan rnyed kyang bor nas kha zas ngan pa 'tshol bar byed pa ltar/ byang sems gang yum 'di rnyed nas bor te nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i sa'i byang chub 'tshol zhing don du gnyer ba byed pa yang de bzhin no/ /kha cig rang la gzhan gyis bsti stang dang bkur sti byed par 'dod par 'gyur zhing*/ rnyed pa 'dod par 'gyur ba dang de dag 'ong ba'i khyim du 'gro 'dod pa'i lta ba dang bcas pa'i sems kyis/ khyim de dag gi mi dang 'dris chen byed pa dang ldan zhing*/ dge ba'i chos byed pa btang bas ni chos min gyi bya ba spyod par 'gyur pa lam bzang po bor te ngan pa'i lam gol du 'gro ba 'di ni bdud kyi las so/ /sems can gang dag sher phyin ston pa de yi tshe 'dun cing dad par gyur nas/ chos kyi dam pa yum 'di ni nyan du song ba las chos nyan pa po de dag gis ni chos smra ba po bya byed mang po dang ldan par rig nas/ chos nyan pa la dga' ba med cing yid mi bde bar gyur nas 'gro ste/ yum 'chad nyan byed pa de'i tshe na mi mthun pa'i bdud kyi las 'di lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang de'i tshe na sems can gang dag gis yum 'chad pa po'i dge slong mang po'i sems dkrugs nas sher phyin 'di 'dzin par mi 'gyur ba'i bar du gcod pa rnam pa mang po gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na rin po che rin thang med pa zhig rnyed par gyur pa gang dag yin pa de dag ni dkon la/ rnyed kyang rin po che de rku 'phrog 'dod nas dus rnams rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang ngo*/ /de bzhin du rgyal ba'i yum rin po che'i chos kyang dkon la/ 'di 'dri sgom byed pa'i mi la rtag tu 'tshe ba'am mang ngo*/

/theg pa chen po la gsar du zhugs pa'i sems can blo chung ba gang zhig dkon pa'i rin po che'i yum 'di 'tshol zhing ma rnyed pa de la/ mi rnyed pa'i phyir du bar chad bya ba'i phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa yon tan ni/ 'on kyang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis yum 'tshol mkhan de dag yongs su 'dzin pa la sbyor bar mdzad de/ dper na bu mang po yod pa'i ma zhig na bar gyur pa la bu ni mang po yod pa de dag kun yid mi bde zhing*/ ma de la nad sos pa'i ched rim gro byed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas kun kyang*/ rgyal ba'i yum du 'gyur pa sher phyin dam pa 'di dang 'dzin pa la dgongs par mdzad do/ /'di ni rgyan las/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de nas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ yum gsum na mdo tshig shin tu mang yang*/ 'dir ni/ gang dag 'das dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mgon gang dang*/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad mang po zhig gis cung zad bsdus nas 'chad cing*/ mtshan nyid la shes pa dang khyad par dang byed pa gsum dang ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bzhi'o/ /dang po shes mtshan la gsum las dang po gzhi shes sbyor ba ni/ rgyal ba gang dag 'das pa dang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi mgon po gang da lta bzhugs pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rgyal ba gang 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad yum 'di las 'byung bas/ yum 'di 'jig rten gyi ston pa rgyal ba rnams kyi skyed byed kyi yum yin la/ de dag sangs rgyas nas sems can rnams kyi sems kyi spyod pa dang mthun pa'i chos ston par byed do/ /de yang chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa'i sgo nas don mdzad pa yin te/ 'jig rten sems can gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang*/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i de bzhin nyid dang*/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i de bzhin nyid rnams ni rigs gcig pa nyid yin te/

de ni bden pa'i dngos po dang bral ba'i bden stong ste/ rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod pa min pa'i de bzhin nyid do/ /de sangs rgyas kyis de ltar gzigs pa'i sher phyin brnyes pa'i sgo nas rang gi mkhyen cing gzigs pa de bzhin du gzhan la ston to/ /'di ni rgyan las/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /gnyis pa lam shes sbyor ba ni/ mkhas pa 'jig rten gnas sam zhes sogs kyis ston cing*/ mkhas pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten du gnas sam/ mya ngan las 'das kyang rung ste chos rnams bden pas stong pa'i chos nyid 'gyur pa'i skyon med pa chos rnams kyi stong pa nyid 'di ni mi 'gyur bar rtag tu gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang rang lam dang sangs rgyas nas de bzhin nyid 'dir rjes su rtogs shing mngon du byas pa na de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dang sangs rgyas zhes mtshan gsol te/ sher phyin gyi dga' ba'i tshal la brten pa'i stobs bcu mnga' ba'i rnam 'dren rnams kyi spyaud yul ni sher phyin 'di yin te/ 'di bshad pa la brten nas sems can rnams sdug bsngal dang ngan song gsum gyi gnas las yongs su 'don par mdzad kyang sangs rgyas de dag ni nam yang sems can du bden pa'i 'du shes skye bar 'gyur ba med do/ /de ji ltar ston zhe na/ dper na seṅge ni ri chen po'i sul phyogs gcig tu gzhan la 'jigs pa med par gnas shing rigs phra mo mang po skrag par byed cing sgra sgrogs pa ltar/ mi yi seṅge sangs rgyas rnams kyang sher phyin la brten nas gnas shing*/ bdag tu lta ba'i mu stegs can mang po skrag par byed cing 'jig rten la bden stong gi sgra chen po yang sgrogs so/ /'di ni rgyan las/ stong pa'i mtshan ma med bcas dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /gsum pa rnams mkhyen sbyor ba ni/ dper na nam mkhar gnas pa'i zhes sogs kyis ston cing*/

dper na nam mkha' la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis ni sa 'di'i rlan bsher rnams skem par byed cing*/ gzugs kyang gsal bar rab tu ston par byed do/ /de bzhin du chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas kyang sher phyin 'di la brten nas stong pa'i chos bstan te srid pa ste 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i chu klung skem par byed cing chos kyang rab tu ston par mdzad do/ /chos nyid ji ltar mthong nas ston ce na/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad pa'i tshe dang*/ don dam la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ngo bor gzugs rnams mi mthong zhing med la/ de bzhin du tshor ba dag dang 'du shes dang 'du byed sems pa dang rnam par shes pa dang sems dang yid rnams mthong ba med do/ /de ltar kun rdzob kyi snang ba mthong ba med pa'i stong pa mthong ba 'di ni/ dam pa'i chos stong nyid mthong ba yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan to/ /de'i dpe ni 'jig rten na nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can rnams kyis tshig gis rab tu brjod par byed mod/ nam mkha' ji ltar mthong bar 'jog tshul ni dgag bya sgrib thogs med par mthong ba na de mthong bar 'jog zhes pa'i don 'di nyid du brtag ste shes par gyis shigadape de ltar dgag bya bden grub dang kun rdzob kyi spros pa ma mthong ba na dam pa'i chos stong nyid mthong ba yang de bzhin gshegs pas bshed pas bstan te/ stong nyid mthong ba'i dpe bshad pa ltar shes par bya'i/ dpe gzhan gyis mthong tshul de ji lta ba bzhin mi go zhing bsnyad par nus pa ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis de ltar mthong ba de yis ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid kun mthong bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di ni rgyan las/ de bzhin nyid kyi chos bstan nas/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de dag gis shes pa'i mtshan nyid bcu drug pa phrag gsum bstan nas/ gnyis pa khyad mtshan bcu drug ni/

rgyal po gtang snyoms 'dug cing zhes sogs kyis ston cing*/ dper na rgyal po btang snyoms la 'dug cing blon pos las kun byed pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang nyan thos kyi chos rnams ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang sher phyin gyis byed do/ /yang dper na rgyal po ni grong dang grong khyer yul 'khor rnams su mi 'gro bar rang gi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i yul gyi mi'i 'bru sogs dpya khral 'du ba thams cad sdud pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid de phyogs gang du'ang mi 'gro yang rang lam dang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan gang yin thams cad kyang sdud par 'gyur ro/ /yang byang sems gang la bde bar gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' mchog rnams la dad pa brtan po yod cing*/ sher phyin mchog 'di la bsam zhing bsgom pa'i sbyor ba la gnas pa de ni/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi sa gnyis las shin tu 'das par byas nas des zil gyis mi non pa'i rgyal ba'i byang chub myur du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /dper na rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa'i gru ni rgya mtsho'i nang du chag cing zhig par gyur te/ de'i nang gi mi gang dag rgya mtshor shi ba'i mi la sogs pa'i ro'am rtswa'am shing lta bu la ni mi 'ju mi 'dzin pa de ni/ rgya mtsho'i chu'i dbus su 'jig par 'gyur te rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs su phyin par mi 'gyur la/ mi gang zhig de dag 'dzin pa ni rgya mtsho'i pha rol gyi 'gram ngogs su phyin par 'gyur ro/ /dpe de ltar chos la dad pa dang ldan cing dang pa'i gus pa thob pa'i mi gang zhig ni/ sher phyin yum 'di la rjes su mi 'jug pa'i mi de skye rga na 'chi dang mya ngan sogs kyi rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i 'khor pa'i rgya mtsho der ni rtag tu 'khor bar 'gyur ro/ /dad sogs dang ldan pa'i mi gang de sher phyin mchog gis yongs su zin pa na/ dngos po'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid la mkhas shing don dam bden pa de gzhan la ston par byed do/

/de dag ni thabs byang chub kyi sems dang snying rje chen po dang sbyin sogs kyi yon tan dang*/ sher phyin gyis yongs su zin na mchog tu rmad du byung ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i byang chub la myur du reg par 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na mi la las ni rdza bum so ma btang ba'i nang du chu skyed na ni/ rdza bum de nyam chung po'i phyir na myur du zhig cing 'jig par rig par bya la/ so btang ba'i bum par chu skyed pa ste blugs shing 'khyer na gang du 'gro ba'i lam du 'jig par 'gyur ba'i 'jigs pa med cing bde bar khyim du phyin par 'gyur ro/ /dpe de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' kha cig chos la dad pa dang don gnyer mang bar gyur kyang*/ sher phyin las rnam par nyams na ni myur du 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor zhing nyan rang gi sar lhung nas ma rung bar 'gyur ro/ /dad sogs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas shes rab de ni yongs su zin par gyur na nyan rang gis gnyis las shin tu 'das te sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mchog thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na bcos legs par ma byas pa'i gru ni rgya mtshor zhugs na rgya mtsho'i nang du nor dang bcas shing tshong par bcas shing tshong bar bcas te 'jig par 'gyur la/ gru de legs par bcos legs byas pa dang ldan par gyur na ni gru mi 'jig pas/ mi nor dang bcas par rgya mtsho'i ngogs su phyin par 'gyur ro/ /dpe de ltar byang sems de thabs dad pas yongs su bsgos kyang*/ sher phyin med na 'khor mtsho dang dman pa'i lam du lhung nas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las ni myur du nyams par 'gyur la/ dad pa de nyid sher phyin mchog dang ldan na rma rmas shing ma nyams par rgyal ba'i byang chub la reg par 'gyur ro/ /yang dper na lo brgya dang nyi shu lta bu lon te rgas shing sdug bsngal ba'i mi ni langs kyang*/ bdag nyid 'gro bar nus pa ma yin te de ni 'gro ba'i skabs su g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mi gzhan gyis brten par byas na ni/

'gyel 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa med cing bde blag tu 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang sems shes rab stobs chung ba ni theg chen lam du rab tu zhugs par gyur kyang bar du nyams par 'gyur la/ byang sems de nyid dad sogs kyi thabs dang sher phyin mchog gis yongs su zin na bar du mi nyams par de bzhin gshegs kyi byang chub la reg par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gi skabs su shes rab dang sher phyin zhes 'byung ba ni gtso bor lam sher phyin te/ byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes khyad par can rnams so/ /khyad mtshan thob pa'i rgyu ni/ byang chub sems dpa' so skye dang po'i las kyi sar gnas pa gang zhig lhag pa'i bsam pas/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mchog thob pa'i ched du zhugs pa slob ma bzang po bla ma la gus pa dang ldan pa de dag gis ni/ yongs 'dzin bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya ste/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na mkhas pa'i yon tan rnams bla ma de las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gis sher phyin 'di rjes su ston pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten to zhes yon tan kun gyi mchog rnam mkhyen mnga' ba'i rgyal bas ni de skad gsung ngo*/ /bshes gnyen des sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar drug ni rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas/ nyan rang gi byang chub tu mi bsngo bar sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar gyis la/ thob bya'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ni bden grub kyi phung por zhen pa'i sgo nas mchog tu 'dzin par ma byed ces/ dang po'i las can de la de skad ces bstan cing bshad par bya'o/ /'di ni rgyan las/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /de dag gis khyad mtshan bstan nas gsum pa byed pa'i mtshan nyid bcu gcig ni/

de ltar spyod pa legs 'tsho smra ba'i zla ba rnams/ /zhes sogs kyis ston te/ gong du bshad pa de ltar spyod pa'i sgo nas legs par 'tsho ba'i smra ba zla ba bshes gnyen rnams ni/ 'gro ba'i skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang gnas dang rten dang gling dang yongs 'dren dang don 'dod pa dang gsal byed kyi sgron ma dang chos kyi mchog smra ba dang mi 'khrugs pa yin te/ rim pa bzhin du sems can gyi don byed pa dang phan pa'i gzhi dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sel ba dang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang*/ mtha' gnyis spangs pa dang lam bzang por 'khrid pa dang 'dod don sgrub pa dang blang dor gsal ba dang chos kyi mchog myang 'das smra ba dang bdud sogs kyis dkrugs par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /grags pa chen po dang ldan pa'i byang sems rnams kyis sems can gyi don du bya dka' ba'i go cha gyon pa ni bya ba sgrub dka' ba la yang 'jug par byed pa yin gyi/ rang gi phung po lnga dang khams bcwo brgyad dang skye mched bcu gnyis lta bu srung ba'i ched du min no/ /nyan rang dang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gsum la bden zhen gyi 'du shes dang bral zhing*/ blang dor gyi chos gang la yang bden zhen gyis yongs su bzung ba med do/ /rang gzhan gyi don phun tshogs las mi ldog pa dang g.yo ba med cing*/ don gnyis byed pa dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir yid mi 'khrugs pa'i chos can yin te de dang ldan pa'o/ /'di ni rgyan las/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad do/ /bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug ni/ de dag 'di 'dra'i chos dang zhes sogs kyis ston te/ byang sems de dag ni 'di 'dra ba'i chos dang ldan zhing bden 'dzin gyi spros pa med pa/ chos 'di lta bu la the tshom dang som nyi dang yid gnyis bral zhing yang dag pa'i ye shes gyi don dang ldan no/ /de dag sher phyin 'di thos na yid the tshom gyis mi nus pa dang*/

gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa ste gang la ma bltos pa dang rang gis las 'og tu phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o/ / 'dren pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sher phyin 'di zab pas don mthong bar dka' ste/ theg pa 'og ma ba sus kyang don ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa med cing rang lam nas thob par 'gyur na med do/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir gzhan la phan par mdzad pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas brnyes ma thag nas ni/ gdul bya thams cad la chos zab mo 'di ston par bzhed kyang gdul bya'i sems can rnams ni lta ba ngan pa gzhan gyi dbang du song bar gzigs te/ de sems can gyi tshogs 'di rnams kyi nang nas chos zab mo 'di sus shes te shes mkhan dkon no snyam du dgongs nas/ re zhig chos mi gsungs shing btang snyoms su thugs khral chung bar mdzad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni gdul bya'i sems can rnams ni yid bden zhen gyis gnas pa la dga' zhing yul 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams 'dod cing don du gnyer ba dang de dag 'dzin pa la gnas shing*/ mi mkhas pa dang blun pa dang rmongs pa dang mun pa bzhin du gyur te bden stong gi tshul mi shes la/ rtogs bya dang thob par bya ba'i chos rnams don dam par gnas pa med cing der 'dzin pa byar med do/ /rgyu mtshan des na 'jig rten pa dag dang sangs rgyas gnyis bden par yod med la rtsod pa 'byung ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis chos rnams bden stong du ston cing 'jig rten pas bden par zhen cing 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na nam mkha'i khams de ni shar la sogs pa phyogs bcu ji snyed pa de rnams na'ang khyab cing yod pas/ de'i tshe de ni phyogs bcu dang de dag tu yod pa'i chos rnams dang ngo bo gcig tu song nas ngo bo rigs mi 'dra ba'i tha dad du gyur pa med do/ /de bzhin du 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar yod pa'i dus gsum gyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa dang*/
